pr.title: AUT-003: Automate approved task queues with durable continuation
pr.body:
Closes #11. Part of #1 and [the extraction epic](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/issues/74).

An approved queue previously required coordination between tasks, roles, rework and GitHub stages. AUT-003 adds one configured operation service and CLI over the existing supervisor: it executes the authorized dependency order, retains identities and budgets across interruption, reconciles publication and merge effects, and continues after native controlled completion.

Reviewed candidate: `58a2c8eafa8122a0e5c5480fe32cc3d14cc0b392`, based on main at `38dea54d2940027ebb93619bbc70d9a5b5a91343`, on `automation/aut-003-unattended-supervisor`. Admission verifies accepted [AUT-002 PR #28](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/28) and the [MIG-003 seed PR #15](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/15); historical prerequisites remain evidence-backed admission edges.

| Acceptance criterion | Implementation and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-01: dependent queue | One approved plan completes two dependent tasks in order; replay adds no work. |
| AC-02: existing owners | Isolated roles, validators, independent native review gates, legal rework, PR/CI and controlled merge retain their existing authorities. |
| AC-03: attempts and budgets | Semantic rework records successors; infrastructure retry retains identity; immutable charges and bounded polling/retry/rework counters survive restart. |
| AC-04: no duplicated effects | Workspace ownership, original sessions, dispatch fences and reconciliation cover competing starts and uncertain push/PR/merge responses. |
| AC-05: actionable exceptions | Scope/plan/grant mismatch, drift, clarification, exhausted budgets and unsafe recovery stop with durable reasons. |
| AC-06: truthful controls | Control acknowledgments bind their exact request; cancellation, deadline and revocation fence subsequent effects; uncertain writers require verified drain before resume. |
| AC-07: shared installed service | The CLI delegates to the configured public service; installed JS, TypeScript, CLI, manual and non-npm consumers pass. Ownership aligns with IPTFantasyFootball #75. |

All nine local checks pass: native build/test (950 Node tests), schema fixtures, 53 repository contract/task records, nine Python tests, seed provenance, adversarial guard mutations, and installed conformance, with dependency installation included in the retained command record. Independent QA additionally passed four focused Linux cases and seven installed Windows cases.

[Exact-head CI run](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/actions/runs/44173220629) verifies source tests, schemas/provenance, reproducible candidate bytes, and installed consumers on Ubuntu/Windows with Node 22/24. All eight jobs pass. Linux ran 950 tests with no failures or skips. Windows ran 950 tests: 936 passed, zero failed/cancelled, and 14 existing Linux-only isolated-runtime cases were skipped. Every AUT-003 operation scenario ran on Windows.

Exact local commands all exited 0 at the reviewed head:

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm ci` | PASS |
| `python -m pip install -r schemas/requirements.txt` | PASS |
| `npm run build` | PASS; native build@3 |
| `npm test` | PASS; native test@3, 950 Node tests |
| `python schemas/validate_fixtures.py` | PASS |
| `python schemas/validate_repository_contracts.py` | PASS; 53 records |
| `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'` | PASS; 9 tests |
| `python scripts/seed_export.py` | PASS |
| `npm run test:adversarial:mutations` | PASS; both weakened guards detected |
| `npm run pack:candidate -- <candidate-directory>` | PASS; reproducible bytes |
| `npm run test:conformance -- <candidate-directory>` | PASS; three top-level suites and three explicitly counted installed operation scenarios |

Checks manifest SHA-256: `4e520ec1102a28f440fc7c8a789e0be8f1e3d33f067c67a35b59b481c339ec49`. Original failed validation/review records were retained through legal native rework.

The installed real-provider rehearsal completed two native fixture tasks using eight fresh isolated role sessions and two actual validator subprocesses. Remote GitHub ports are explicitly simulated. This PR's actual CI, independent reviews and native controlled completion establish live delivery. Original proof source `764852560b940c21bae18772e28d12acccf67118` is preserved; the final successor only changes tests/harness and produces identical package bytes.

Private candidate `0.1.0-rc.4` SHA-256: `553916414a69808088a40da71c6c2e439c0edab1bd8f7f06de8cb80a22a761f8`.
Proof report SHA-256: `7ab5c9708e0717fcaecf89ee18a0c3f7d84477a60cf611f22bbe476db0eeda85`.
Final artifact-equivalence record SHA-256: `a8880b9ba481b8bb583699b48dce702b5f7a1d69745e332213f13ef4e7490836`.

Final independent reviews approve this exact head; native review gates reached MERGE_READY. Prior failures and rejected judgments remain in history.

| Role | Report | Native evidence | Report SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QA | [PASS](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/29#issuecomment-6961039686) | `AUT-003::role::QA@2` | `e8ab690dfa1ff90267f59885fcfa901823d21729cad18046f3b91d898df4b292` |
| Architecture | [PASS](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/29#issuecomment-6962756408) | `AUT-003::role::Architect@2` | `91b2f75c1c14732bbcae7754f816c10d06d53b12722c6e4901094229693a4c37` |
| UAT/Product | [PASS](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/29#issuecomment-6962938158) | `AUT-003::role::UAT/Product@1` | `9d98410062034178da3ec1b54e69558641a097b3c407cb123a65e8e5b8e37a80` |

Compatibility and rollback are documented in `docs/WORKFLOW_DRIVER.md` and `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`. rc.4 preserves existing rc.3 histories; older readers refuse new operation records. Disable new admission, drain and verify writers, retain the original package/config/history and budgets, then step the original operation with `resume --once`. Do not reset history to force a downgrade. Windows supports process-interruption recovery; directory durability differs from POSIX. Runtime grants and provider records remain private. No package release or protection change.


Merged as `d6f7c3b6ad1d6c0ad1e059485b97d582759c388d` after all final reviews and checks passed. The native controller recorded `AUT-003::merge@1` and `DONE`; #11 is closed. [Controlled completion and post-merge verification](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/pull/29#issuecomment-6963070063).

pr.body:
Closes #82

Coordinates Fantasy Football #1 and #74, and Brain-Crumbs/Vibez#1.

## Reviewed admission

Admission-only commit `ce0c0f3c6d2af1364d5117f35e68d428b062903f` was independently reviewed before the native start. The evidence below distinguishes that prerequisite review from the final cleanup reviews.

- Base is current Fantasy Football main, `c7fa639539d2f92a36a59a1bb2fd4630d7fbd7d2`. The native MIG-009 dependency remains backed by the original Ubuntu/ext4 rc.2 workflow record, `MIG-009::merge@1`, and [PR #86](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/pull/86).
- The existing package lock, project config, bound profile and MIG-009 definition and receipt are retained. The revised #82 issue text, hash, requirement, staged definition and admission receipt agree. The review checks the exact registration revision before native start.
- Existing rc.2 history matches its protected backup and offline restore across 141 runtime files. The Windows historical backup/restore pairs match all 119 files. The live canary archive checkout has a preexisting package.json difference; its runtime matches the archive, and both preserved copies still contain the pinned package file.
- `npm run migration:check`, `npm run test:consumer` (three passing tests), `python3 schemas/validate_fixtures.py`, `python3 schemas/validate_repository_contracts.py` (61 records) and `git diff --check` passed on the registration revision.

[Independent admission approval](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/pull/87#issuecomment-6925857103).

## Cleanup and acceptance

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-01 | [Native MIG-009 completion and accepted rollback](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/pull/86); revised source-body, requirement and definition hashes verified by independent admission review. |
| AC-02 | The exact 249 deletions match all removal candidates in the accepted 331-path adoption tree. Project inputs, config, archived definitions, receipts, and off-tree evidence remain available. |
| AC-03 | The exact immutable Vibez rc.2 lockfile artifact is the only installed engine. The supported npm adapter uses public exports. Focused regressions confirm that the guard rejects copied or relocated source/schema files and commented private-module imports. The staged-plan audit continues to reject mismatched issue hashes and dropped prerequisites. |
| AC-04 | The native driver selected only MIG-010 against genuine MIG-009 DONE. The rework attempt `790370f3-6b70-2805-fd3a-e7dd497bcd53` preserves predecessor `e666e4cc-afce-413f-a912-126c6ce978d9` and the audited QA transport rejection. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/actions/runs/43938063380) retains all four configured jobs. |
| AC-05 | In an isolated Ubuntu checkout, reverting both cleanup commits restored the exact tracked admission files and working rc.2 version/status. All retained links to removed paths now resolve to the immutable adoption tree. All 141 original rc.2 runtime files still match their hashes. The protected Windows archives and offline restores match 119/119 inputs; the original canary checkout's previously observed package difference is outside this cleanup. |
| AC-06 | The [cleanup and #74 evidence map](docs/MIG-010-cleanup.md) records consumer ownership, the final post-checkpoint reconciliation, historical links, CI and rollback procedure. |

Validation on Ubuntu 24.04/ext4 and Node 24.18.0 included `npm ci --engine-strict`, `npm run build`, the native npm test validator, the installed CLI version/status, `python3 scripts/validate-consumer-records.py` (33 records), `git diff --check`, exact removal inventory, and the stopped-writer rollback and history checks. The CI matrix uses Ubuntu 24.04/Node 22 and Windows Server 2025/Node 24.

The project/worktree config, required CI names, existing validator IDs, Vibez pin, task and history identities, and persisted schemas are preserved. The old embedded engine remains available only through its pinned historical checkout and readers. See the cutover guide for stopping and verifying writers before rollback.

The rework head is `ea23d4c6f3e20911f26c9459e7b7acdc9b2cd2c8`. All four exact-head CI jobs passed. Fresh independent QA, Architecture and UAT judgments are required by the native gates before ready conversion and controlled merge.
